Name: Sunmist Vale (Stardew Retexture)
Author: pegfingers
Description:
[img]https://files.catbox.moe/41mdub.png[/img]
[center][i][color=#efefef][font=Sans-serif][size=2]Retextures Stardew Valley in a consistent, modern style, without straying too far from vanilla.
  [/size][/font][/color][/i][/center]
[img]https://files.catbox.moe/3xz5l1.png[/img]
[img]https://files.catbox.moe/za6e6r.png[/img]
[color=#efefef][font=Sans-serif][size=3]      Have you ever played Stardew Valley, especially since 1.5, and noticed the sheer amount of major inconsistencies between item texture styles? [b]Sunmist Vale[/b] solves this, with what will eventually become a full resprite of Stardew Valley, as well as various major mods such as SVE (which already has some portrait resprites!) and Cornucopia.
      Sunmist Vale is a faithful reimagining of Stardew Valley if its textures were made today, rather than 10 years ago. These textures are more in-line with ConcernedApe's latest updates, aiming for greater consistency. This texture pack currently [u]only[/u] resprites tools, various crafting materials, and 6 SVE portraits as of 0.3.0. However, more textures will come soon! Most gems, crops, and artisan goods have already been textured*, I simply need to find the time to implement them.
      Don't like a certain texture? No problem! You can use the in-game config with GMCM to disable any category of textures (e.g. tools, resources, etc.) instantly! Or, you can scroll to the [u]Advanced[/u] section to disable any texture you want, individually. Compatibility is currently untested, but this should allow you to have other retexture mods in your game at the same time!
      If you enjoy [b]Sunmist Vale[/b], please consider endorsing the mod and/or sharing it with friends. While I don't accept donations, I would appreciate the recognition! [/size]

[size=2][i]* Some of these unimplemented textures can be seen in the banner.[/i][/size][/font][/color]
